result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products whose quantity is 0. The full test suite passes (`mvn -q -o test`, no failures). I didn't add a test for the zero-quantity case.

The change is one line in `DataStore.listStockLevelsInWarehouse` in `DataStore.java`. The query now has `AND s.quantity > 0`, the same filter the other stock overviews use.

Asking for the quantity of a single product in a warehouse uses a different method (`findStockQuantityInWarehouse`), which I didn't touch. Nuts in WH-1 should still answer 0, though I didn't check that case directly.
